description: This is a Java Spring Boot controller class that manages endpoints related to assignment submissions within a Learning Management System. It provides methods for submitting assignments and grading submissions, integrating security, validation, and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: SubmissionController
classes.description: A REST controller managing assignment submission and grading endpoints, secured with JWT and role-based access.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles the creation or update of a student's assignment submission based on provided data.

methods.name: grade
methods.description: Allows an instructor or admin to grade a specific submission.
